allowed_fallback_models.title: Allowed Fallback Models
allowed_fallback_models.description: Model IDs this model accepts as `fallbacks[i].model` on the Messages API. An empty list means the `fallbacks` parameter is not supported for this model as primary.

capabilities.description: Object mapping capability names to their support details. Keys are always present for all known capabilities.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string representing the time at which the model was released. May be set to an epoch value if the release date is unknown.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: A human-readable name for the model.

max_input_tokens.title: Max Input Tokens
max_input_tokens.description: Maximum input context window size in tokens for this model.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum value for the `max_tokens` parameter when using this model.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Object type.

For Models, this is always `"model"`.
